annotations.title: ICS Threat Actor ASN Infrastructure Profiling

description: Profiles an ASN for ICS threat actor infrastructure use. Returns actor associations (SANDWORM, VOLTZITE, XENOTIME), phishing kit links (Tycoon2FA, EvilProxy, NakedPages), bulletproof hosting indicators, abuse categories (c2, staging, phishing), and an OT-specific blocking recommendation with WAF rule hint. Price: $0.03 USDC per call via x402 on Base mainnet. An unpaid call returns an x402 PaymentRequired challenge; retry the identical call with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"].

asn.description: ASN identifier e.g. AS215540, AS9009, AS29802

org.description: Optional org name fragment e.g. hivelocity, m247
